feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef is grass fed and finished.

notes: Unpublished 2026-11-15: the farm's Eat From Farms site names no town or address (Damascus, AR comes only from a 2021 to 2022 blog listing), the farm pickup page failed to load, and the shop page lists only pastured chicken, pastured pork and grass fed lamb with no stock status and no beef. Check the farm's town, whether grass-finished beef is currently for sale (the homepage says the beef is grass fed and finished), and where farm pickup happens. Checked the homepage and shop. Homepage says it sells from the farm most days by text or call (503-803-9253) and through Bramble Market (Little Rock), Me and McGhee Market (North Little Rock), Bell Urban Farmstand (Conway) and other Arkansas locations. Chickens are on green grass most of their life with supplemental feed, eggs are pasture raised, pigs graze and root in pastures and forests, and lambs are grass fed and raised by the family's daughters. No delivery, shipping or bulk shares found.
